quotations.english: with no faults on her part, undeservedly; gratis

source_text: un-syn[n], e; f. Not guilt, not crime :-- Ne húru Hildeburh herian þorfte Eótena treowe; unsynnum (with no faults on her part, undeservedly; gratis. Cf. un-synnig, II) wearð beloren leófum æt ðam lindplegan, bearnum and bróðrum, Beo. Th. 2149; B. 1072.
